cues.text: In Paulownia Mall's Fountain Square, Chihiro walks a few steps ahead of you, then turns back to you, smiling.
She hurries off across the square, and you walk away to wait for her. Later, as she stands on her own, a young man walks up and stops in front of her.
You walk over to them and face the man. The man turns and walks away.
Chihiro runs off across the square.
